verdict: Lead volume is down this week; cost per lead and setup delays need resolving.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 127 leads at an average cost of $8.23 per lead, but the most recent 7 days showed a sharp shift: leads fell 21% while spend rose 13%, pushing cost per lead up 43% week-over-week. The last three days of the period averaged 2.7 leads per day versus 6.7 leads per day in the three days prior, so the trend is still moving in the wrong direction. A key part of this picture is that conversion tracking has not yet been completed, meaning some downstream activity — calls, form fills, appointments — is not being captured and the numbers above under-report actual outcomes. We are resolving the tracking setup and reviewing the primary ad campaign's targeting and creative this week to arrest the cost-per-lead climb; expect a clearer, more accurate read on lead quality once tracking is live.
